subject: Physics
plan_title: Teaching Plan (Board-order, dual CET + NDA weight)
notes: Physics differs from Chemistry: NDA Physics is SUBSTANTIAL (~449 PYQs across genuine physics chapters - Optics 97, Electricity & Magnetism 93, Mechanics, Heat, Sound), a real co-driver alongside MHT-CET. So both the CET and NDA columns carry real weight (dual-weight), on a board-order spine (the board sequence is already dependency-sound).
14 board chapters in board order, grouped into 5 phases (foundations/mechanics -> heat & sound -> optics -> electricity & magnetism -> semiconductors).

NCERT-11 (rationalised) places Optics, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetism, EM Waves and Semiconductors in Class 12 - so board XI chapters 9-14 are NCERT-11 gaps (Maharashtra front-loads them, like Maths).

guiding_principles.meaning: XI Physics is driven by BOTH MHT-CET and NDA (unlike Chemistry, where NDA was basic). Units follow the dependency-sound board order; both the CET and NDA columns carry genuine PYQ frequencies.
NDA Physics tests genuine physics at ~Class 11-12 level (Optics 97, Electricity & Magnetism 93 are its biggest chapters). The NDA column is populated throughout, not a basic overlay.
Foundations/Mechanics -> Heat & Sound -> Optics -> Electricity & Magnetism -> Semiconductors, following the board sequence.

phases.name: Foundations & Mechanics
phases.blurb: Units, vectors, kinematics, laws of motion, gravitation, elasticity - the mechanics core for both exams.

phases.name: Heat & Sound
phases.blurb: Thermal properties of matter and the physics of sound and waves.

phases.name: Optics
phases.blurb: Ray optics - NDA's single biggest physics chapter (97 PYQs); NCERT places it in Class 12.

phases.name: Electricity & Magnetism
phases.blurb: Electrostatics, current electricity, magnetism, EM waves - high weight in both exams; NCERT Class 12.

phases.name: Semiconductors
phases.blurb: Band theory, intrinsic/extrinsic semiconductors, p-n junction - intro at XI (device depth is XII).

units.title: Units and Measurements
units.why_here: SI units, dimensions, error analysis, measurement of length/mass/time. Foundational; CET 15, NDA 14.

units.title: Mathematical Methods
units.why_here: Vector analysis and operations, calculus basics - the mathematical toolkit for physics. Board-specific; feeds kinematics.

units.title: Motion in a Plane
units.why_here: Rectilinear & 2-D motion, equations of motion, projectile, relative velocity, uniform circular motion. CET 58, NDA 24.

units.title: Laws of Motion
units.why_here: Newton's laws & applications, types of forces, friction, impulse/momentum/collisions. (Work-Energy-Power is split out into its own unit — NCERT Ch.5.) CET 48, NDA 41+23.

units.title: Work, Energy and Power
units.board_source: Part I, Ch. 4 (Work & Energy) · NCERT Ch. 5
units.why_here: Work, work-energy theorem, energy conservation & power. The State Board folds this into Laws of Motion (Ch.4); NCERT gives it a standalone chapter (Ch.5), so it is split out here as its own unit — CBSE students get a clean chapter match, State students meet it in sequence right after Laws of Motion. Tested by both CET and NDA.

units.title: Gravitation
units.why_here: Kepler's laws, universal gravitation, variation of g, gravitational PE & escape velocity, satellites. CET 85, NDA 17.

units.title: Mechanical Properties of Solids
units.why_here: Elasticity, stress-strain, Hooke's law, elastic moduli. Low weight both (CET 6).

units.title: Thermal Properties of Matter
units.why_here: Temperature, thermal expansion, calorimetry, heat transfer & radiation. CET 89 (Radiation 55), NDA 39.

units.title: Sound
units.why_here: Wave properties, speed of sound, pipes/resonance/beats, Doppler effect, applications. CET 51, NDA 34.

units.title: Optics
units.why_here: Reflection, mirrors, refraction, TIR, lenses, prisms, optical instruments. NDA's #1 physics chapter (97); CET 79 (ray). NCERT-11 gap (Class 12).

units.title: Electrostatics
units.why_here: Electric charge, Coulomb's law, electric field (XI level; potential/capacitors/Gauss are XII). CET (Electrostatics spans XI+XII 171); NDA E&M 93. NCERT-11 gap.

units.title: Electric Current Through Conductors
units.why_here: Current, drift, Ohm's law, energy & power, resistor combinations. CET (Current Electricity 93); NDA E&M. NCERT-11 gap.

units.title: Magnetism
units.why_here: Bar magnet, magnetic field, Gauss's law of magnetism, earth's magnetism (XI level). CET (Magnetic Materials 35); NDA E&M. NCERT-11 gap.

units.title: Electromagnetic Waves and Communication System
units.why_here: EM waves, electromagnetic spectrum, communication systems. Board-specific; NCERT-11 gap (EM Waves is Class 12).

units.title: Semiconductors
units.why_here: Band theory, intrinsic/extrinsic semiconductors, p-n junction & diode (XI intro; transistors/logic gates are XII). CET (Semiconductor Devices 133 is XII-heavy); NCERT-11 gap.
